name: Jaulín (Spain)
description: Red field with a blue triangle edged yellow at the hoist bearing a yellow ring with a swan, and a blue stripe edged yellow across the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Jaulín; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

ring on the triangle and edges of the blue
stripe edged yellow across the fly
